clauses.title: The transport section names the designated output and its read path
requires: the gate envelope is the file at the run's structured output path, as reported by the runner's run status; the parent reads it from that path after completion
A completion notice, wait result, or preview is a courier and never the envelope
`(no output)` in one is transport indeterminacy, not zero output, and the parent must read the path before classifying the run
Zero designated output bytes (CL-D51) means that file is absent or empty after completion
a validated envelope at that path is the verdict whatever the runner's status says
a validation failure at that path remains a tool failure governed by the owning workflow or selected mode's existing retry/fail-stop rule
exact autofix's first-malformed-result terminal rule and CL-D51's zero-byte relaunch remain unchanged

clauses.title: Read-path fixtures pin the section, the CL-D51 pointer, and the record
requires: the transport section names the designated output and its read path
CL-D51 points at the read path it now depends on
CL-D58 records the read path as an application of the no-information principle
